comparison.objective: Tighten a child-seat anchor while pressing the seat into a cushion; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual compression and strap take-up versus counterheld hex-key unlocking, collar rotation, relocking, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: A firmly fitted released seat versus two constrained carriage stops without bottoming, rebound, overload, or lock drift.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is generic; the mechanisms and tested abilities differ. Record has no specs or numeric tightness threshold.
